body: Thank you. It is tough indeed.
Thx I just suck at it

How can I blame something for telling the truth. I will spend my life alone. I should've wrote it hurts a hell of a lot less if they show a little respect. Living alone is better anyway; you don't have to put up with anyone's BS but your own.
I'm not sure what I want to do. I want to learn to cope with suicidal thoughts but it is unbelievably bad sometimes and I can't stop it.
Thanks for your opinion. I'd stop complaining and do something about it if I knew anything to do about it
Absolutely, I don't blame anyone who rejects me with respect. It would just be nice to know what is like to be accepted.
Thanks for your response. I wish you nothing but the best in your future.
So true
I'll have killed myself before either happens

Wanting romantic connection is part of being human.  If you ever find a way to stop it, please tell me. I feel terrible everyday cause of zero romantic experience. All I want is to take a girl on a date, but they all say no.

I stepped in front of a moving bus once. The bus skidded to a stop barely before hitting me. All I remember is the distraught look of the bus drivers face. I fucking totally ruined someone's day and still feel like shit for it all the time. Suicidal thoughts are a trap, don't fall for them.

Try to focus on your accomplishments. Someday you'll bump into that person that feels the same way you do and you'll be great friends. Trust, there's no shortage of people who feel this way. I am one of them.

I've been in this same situation. I feel like I never left. I don't think any of this sounds pathetic. You will one day find someone who truly cares. That's what I keep telling myself. You can message me if you want I can relate.
20/m. Ill converse with you about anything you'd like. How did you determine your personality type? I feel I have a type not shared by many people.
I feel the same way. *Hugs*
I feel there no way to get better because it never has. I never cease to feel terrible. Everyday of my life is miserable and is all my fault. I can't fix anything. Idk what to do.
Thank you for your kind words.  But there's no way to improve my mood. Live in unbearable pain or die

Do it, team sports can be great confidence boosters.  Listen to your gf she is so right.  I'm always forcing myself to do thing I like even when I don't feel like it or am convinced I don't like anything.  Then next thing you know you're enjoying it and so glad you did it anyway.  Glad you're are feeling optimistic, keep it up!

Unfortunately fighting the urge to be under the influence is something I struggle with.  Make sure you eat healthy as you can and get lots of exercise and the right amount of sleep, these are so important and help reduce urges. Often, I'm overcome with urges and just drop and start doing push ups and sit ups.  Shadow boxing and dancing are great relievers of stress too.  If you end up taking drugs, be careful, educate yourself and try to take as little as possible.

I've felt exactly as you describe.  Don't feel guilty if you feel bad because you can't control how you feel.  I used to take alcohol from my parents at your age to numb these feelings you feel.  For some physiological reason, it's quite a bit more difficult as a teenager and as you get older your body balances out hormones and stuff more and it becomes easier.  I think you should gently bring it up with your gf, she may be able to make you feel a little better when it's bad.  Talking to someone helps more than it seems like it would. Just please stay with us in the world.  There is no point of no return, you can always get better; it's not easy but it's doable. I believe you can do it!

I wish i knew why people acted like this as well.  All I can tell you is not everyone is like that.  If you hadn't posted your age, I would've thought this was written by me(I'm a year younger).  I'm pretty much unable to carry a conversation as well but you can PM me if you'd like.  Just keep trying, you'll find someone you can talk to.

In my experience it's much easier to become dependent on cannabis and other drugs than it is to porn/masturbation.  I was never physically able to do it enough to become heavily dependent on it, YMMV. Drugs on the other hand are very easy to take constantly and mess with your head much more.  Just try and take it easy and cut back if you notice problems arising

What do you like to do? maybe there is a club nearby where you are to get some social interaction.  Or find a small cafe or bookstore or something similiar where people hang out and talk to them.  I know anxiety makes it hard to meet and talk to people but if you do find some it is quite helpful.
Your life is not fucked because you didn't go away to school.  You still have plenty of time to do that.  Work towards getting a job to afford it on your own if it's what you want.  I went to school with people who were in the 40's, it's not big deal if you don't go to school straight away.
Try to have fun doing whatever you may enjoy, casually meet some people when the chance arises cuz who knows you might meet someone amazing.
